review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Small Molecule Hormone or Hormone-Like Ligands of Integrin alphaVbeta3, PMCID:PMC10358123
primary_title: L-Thyroxine vs. 3,5,3'-triiodo-L-thyronine and cell proliferation: activation of mitogen-activated protein kinase and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase
decision_basis: The reviews cite a primary study in which T3 binding to alphaVbeta3 is supported by radioligand displacement and integrin antagonism, with T3-specific Src, PI3K and MAPK signaling in human glioblastoma cells.
limitations_preserved: Restrict to the T3-specific alphaVbeta3/Src-PI3K-MAPK branch in U-87 MG cells; T4 is not interchangeable in this assay, and no SCI or nuclear-TR claim is added.

review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Integrin alphaVbeta3 in the Mediating Effects of Dihydrotestosterone and Resveratrol on Breast Cancer Cell Proliferation, PMCID:PMC7216104
primary_title: Androgen-induced human breast cancer cell proliferation is mediated by discrete mechanisms in estrogen receptor-alpha-positive and -negative breast cancer cells
decision_basis: The reviews cite a primary study showing that anti-alphaVbeta3 and an RGD peptide targeting the integrin small-molecule site eliminate DHT-induced proliferation in ER-alpha-negative MDA-MB-231 cells, supporting a bounded alphaVbeta3-dependent DHT response.
limitations_preserved: Restrict to alphaVbeta3-dependent DHT proliferation in ER-alpha-negative MDA-MB-231 cells; the primary study does not provide purified binary binding, and no universal androgen-receptor or SCI inference is added.
